title: Offer It to the Bishop
setup: Your queen on b5 and rook on g6 are aimed at a king with a bishop on e7 for company.
hint: The bishop can only block on one square. Pick the check that makes it choose that square.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qe8+}} forces {{Bf8}} — the bishop cannot take and the king cannot move. {{Qxf8#}} follows: the queen covers g8, and g7 and h7 hold Black's own pawns. The check is not the mate; it is what arranges the mate.
